mainText: Sutton's predictions v Football Manager, the game. BBC Sport football expert Chris Sutton takes on the computer game Football Manager 27, plus the BBC readers and AI, with his predictions for this weekend's Premier League fixtures. Lampard looks for Coventry progress as belief grows. Coventry City could move 11th in the Premier League with victory at Everton on Friday as Frank Lampard returns to the Toffees with his side growing in confidence. Why managers can learn a lot from leaders like Napoleon - Pulis. BBC Sport columnist Tony Pulis explains what he did between jobs and why out-of-work managers can learn a lot from leaders outside of football.

titleText: Other news you might find interesting
mainText: Met chief says he wouldn't be surprised if more allegations made about Brand after rape conviction. Sir Mark Rowley tells the BBC that what he heard reported from Brand's trial came close to "victim blaming". Katherine Ryan says she feels 'grief and relief' after Russell Brand conviction. The comedian had previously spoken about an unnamed "predator" in the entertainment industry. Did a data centre revolt affect the US midterm election results?. BBC Verify examines whether US voters were influenced by the data centre boom - and the impact anti-AI sentiment could have on the industry. 'Misleading' student loans information left out examples of higher-salary repayments. The Treasury Committee chair says she is "shocked" after one university compared repayments to the price of coffee.
